subject: Daily AcreetionOS Update -- November 14, 2026
body:
Daily AcreetionOS Update - November 14, 2026

Dear Community,

We're excited to share the latest developments from the AcreetionOS project. Our community has been actively contributing to the growth and improvement of our sovereign Arch Linux distribution. In this update, we'll highlight some of the recent changes and achievements.

Firstly, we're pleased to announce the release of XRAID, a declustered parity RAID for zoned XFS. This new feature aims to provide a more efficient and reliable storage solution for our users. We're grateful to our community members who have contributed to this development.

In addition to XRAID, we've also issued security updates for various packages, including .NET, Firefox, and the kernel. These updates ensure that our distribution remains secure and up-to-date. We recommend all users to update their systems to the latest packages.

Rust 1.100.0 has been released, and we've updated our build system to reflect the changes. This new version includes several notable improvements, such as the stabilization of the `th` module.

On the development front, cobra3282000 has made significant contributions to Calamares, our universal Linux installer. Recent commits include updates to wayland configs, fixes for shellprocess2 sequence entry, and the addition of a new package, firefox-fix, which restores window position restore on Linux.

Natalie has also been actively working on acreetion-surf, a new version of our web browser. The initial commit for v2.0.0 has been made, and we're excited to see the progress being made.

We're also happy to announce that cobra3282000 has made a commit to force Wayland session as the default desktop environment in Calamares. This change will provide a more seamless experience for our users.

As always, we're grateful for the contributions from our community members. Your efforts are essential to the growth and success of AcreetionOS. If you're interested in getting involved, please join our Discord server or reach out to us through our website.

Thank you for being part of the AcreetionOS community. We're excited to see what the future holds for our project.

Best regards,
Natalie Cole-Clift Spiva and Darren Clift
